title: Diego Maradona's birth chart
metaDescription: Diego Maradona's chart, computed from a sourced birth date: Sun at 7.2° Scorpio. Birth time unknown, so no houses or rising sign.
lede: 0.5° separates the Sun and Pluto from an exact sextile; at that range identity and depth read as one mechanism. A sextile is an offer rather than a given: available when it is reached for, quiet when it is not.

blocks.title: Where the Sun actually stood
blocks.text: At noon on that date the Sun stood at 7.2° Scorpio, inside the first decan (0°–10°), whose traditional sub-ruler is Mars. The decan is the older, finer division — it is what the sign looks like once you stop rounding it to thirty degrees.

blocks.title: Closer to the ground
blocks.text: Mercury holds 23.4° Scorpio, Venus holds 10.9° Sagittarius, Mars holds 15.8° Cancer — in the old shorthand, thought steeped in tone and memory; attraction declared rather than implied; effort that surges when it matters.

blocks.title: The angles that hold
blocks.text: The day's firmest angle joins the Sun and Pluto — a sextile holding at 0.5°. A sextile pays out only on effort; the scheme calls it opportunity rather than gift. Behind it, Neptune sextile Pluto at 1.1°, and the Sun conjunction Neptune at 1.6° — both still well inside the orbs this site uses. The unknown hour cannot unmake any of this: every aspect named survived all twenty-five samples of the day.

blocks.title: What the angles build
blocks.text: The Moon makes no major aspect that survives the day; the old reading gives such a planet autonomy — it acts alone, sometimes loudly.

blocks.title: The classical map
blocks.text: The oldest layer of the scheme — seven planets, four conditions — flags three placements in this chart. Mars in Cancer at 15.8° is in fall — the tradition’s uphill placement, strength earned rather than given; Jupiter in Capricorn at 0.8° is in fall; Saturn in Capricorn at 13.4° is in domicile — the planet in its own sign, running on home rules. The table describes circumstance rather than quality — a planet in detriment is inconvenienced, not diminished.

blocks.title: The shape of the whole
blocks.text: Among the 10 placements whose signs hold for the whole day, the elements divide 5 water, 3 earth, 2 fire; by modality, 4 fixed, 3 mutable, 3 cardinal. No settled placement falls in air — an absence the tradition treats as information, not as a defect. Mercury was retrograde — the optical reversal the tradition reads as review — energy turned over before it is turned out.

blocks.title: The Moon, and how far it can move
blocks.text: The Moon stayed in Pisces for the whole of that day at the birthplace, covering 13.6° between midnight and midnight. The sign survives the missing hour; the degree does not, and is given as a reference rather than a fact. At the noon reference it stands at 19.8°.
